facts.fact: Mmegi reports that the Information and Data Protection Commission issued a determination and enforcement order finding the DPSM E-Payslip portal not fully compliant with the Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024, and DPSM suspended the portal on 22 July 2026.
Mmegi reports in July 2026 that Botswana continues to implement the Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024, under which the Commission monitors compliance and issues enforcement orders.
The Information and Data Protection Commission is acting: it reviewed the E-Payslip portal, issued a determination and enforcement order, and guided DPSM through compliance in July 2026.
The Commission's enforcement order against DPSM and the portal's suspension in July 2026 are a first reported enforcement against a public body in the report.
